about: The Maloja's fixed pattern over the terrain, from WindNinja (tools/map/windninja_pattern.py, Documentation/MALOJA_WIND_RESEARCH.md): don't edit. Layer 1: wind speed / the lake's median speed. Layer 2: the direction the wind comes from minus the lake's mean direction, degrees, positive = turned clockwise (from further right).
format: two float32 little-endian layers (speed factor, then turn), each row by row from the north edge, each row from west to east
lake_strength: from the satellite's roughness map (satellite_wind.py), roughness taken as wind x 1.0
